name: Ogon i voda
source:
Time cannot be turned back.
"Too late" is when a person is no longer alive.
Every second is a chance to change your life.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1673955906]Steam[/url]]
translation:
时间无法倒转。
“太晚了”是指一个人已经不再活着了。
每一秒都是改变你生活的机会。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1673955906]Steam[/url]]
